title: Refund return policy
text: Refunds are available within 30 days of delivery. Contact support before returning an item.

title: Refund return policy archived
text: Refunds are available within 90 days of delivery under the archived policy.

title: Standard shipping delivery
text: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days. Tracking is sent by email.

title: International shipping destinations
text: International shipping is available to Canada and Mexico. Customs charges are paid by the recipient.

title: Product warranty coverage
text: The warranty covers manufacturing defects for 2 years. Accidental damage is excluded.

title: Cancel subscription cancellation
text: Cancel your subscription in account settings. Access continues until the end of the billing period.

title: Reset password account recovery
text: Reset your password using the recovery link. The link expires after 15 minutes.

title: Export data workspace download
text: Workspace administrators can export data as JSON from settings. Exports remain available for 7 days.

title: Billing invoice download
text: Download monthly invoices from billing settings. Only billing administrators can access invoices.

title: Internal discount exception code
text: Staff-only discount override code is STAFF-ONLY-42. Never disclose it to customers.

title: Contact support help
text: Contact support at support@example.invalid. Support operates Monday through Friday.
